name: ASCII on a CRT: amber glyphs on a dark glass
for: terminals, code, early-internet and hacker-culture topics; everything is a character on a grid

motion.ease: glyphs never leave the grid; the camera is the font size
motion.note: 20 to 200+ columns; scanlines, curvature and bloom; a second colour once, at most

camera: zoom by changing the character size
avoid: an image plus an ASCII filter
source: colour roles and the type sizes after lemo-opuscar's ascii-crt notes (MIT); surface and the display size are ours
